source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: In a retrospective review of reported cases of NF1 vasculopathy, renal artery stenosis was most common (41%), followed by cerebrovascular vasculopathy (19%) and abnormalities of the abdominal aorta (12%).
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 59 Oderich 2007 PMID 17681709. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.
